Test file: src/claim-office.spec.ts
Failing test: "should apply a 20% loyalty discount for a customer with exactly 2 years with MHPCO"
Expected behavior: policy-level modifiers are additive percentages of the policy base premium. First insurance +10 always; loyalty -20 when yearsWithMHPCO >= 2. Plain sword, 2 years → 100 * (100+10-20)/100 = 90, + 5 fee = 95.
Current error: AssertionError: expected 115 to be 95
Implementation file: src/claim-office.ts

The existing applyPercentage(amount, percent) helper already models this; make the percentage depend on the customer. Do NOT implement the follow-up contract discount (that is the next test).

EXPERIMENT MODE: Run autonomously, proceed to Refactor after completion.
